notes.title: Demo Update v0.0.2
notes.content:
**General Notes**
Now the reaper can't see you if you're playing a dialogue, but be careful! She can catch you if she saw you already! You can't escape that easy! 

**KNOWN ISSUES (Unresolved)**
I'm working on making the game compatible with square resolutions, for now use 16:9 if possible.

**COMING SOON**
New ghost that gives you more details about your ghost nature, and how the world around you works now that you're dead.
More lights! On key spots, to have conversations without using the flashlight.

**NEW ADDITIONS**
Stay calm if you're playing a dialogue and the reaper appears suddently, now she can't catch you if you're listen to a conversation, unless she was already hunting you! In that case just run! Or hide, your choice.

**Bug Fixes**
Main menu now works on all resolutions! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280590/041efeff8337fb8d7c934a93b7f03991aecce253.png[/img]

notes.title: **Patch Notes: Demo Update v0.0.2**
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280590/b0eb53a7d40d283b3b92a40456f6a1fc7985b912.png[/img]**KNOWN ISSUES (Unresolved)**
Square resolutions don't work

**NEW ADDITIONS**
Flashlight system: when the reaper is chasing the player, using the flashlight will slow him down, and turning it off will speed him up.
Added blood warnings on walls to make this mechanic clear

**Bug Fixes**
Fixed an issue with The reaper, who used to play her killing animation all the time once it damage the player once.
